Biblio.title: The Old Man and the Sea

summary: Koha is a self-hosted integrated library system (ILS) in Perl/MySQL managing patrons, bibliographic records, catalogue items, circulation (checkouts/renewals/returns), holds/reserves, fines and patron accounts, notices/messages, and social features (reviews/ratings/tags/suggestions/virtual shelves).

_no_edges.why: queued notice delivery is a pure message_queue row lifecycle (pending->sent/failed) plus an external SMTP/SMS side effect; it does not write to any other relational entity except Patron debarment via the separately-wired Message.restrict_patron_when_notice_fails link.

stores BorrowerMessagePreference and rewrites PatronMessageTransportPreference rows only; no other entity is affected (message_attributes/message_transports are static config tables owned outside this domain).
Direct SQL DELETE on accountlines with no further entity writes. The zero-balance + age filter prevents triggering any cascade beyond AccountOffset (CASCADE on FK). No trigger chain.
